title: lamium purpureum var. hybridum
intro: Lamium purpureum var. hybridum, commonly known as Purple Dead Nettle, is a perennial plant in the mint family (Lamiaceae) and is often cultivated for its ornamental value due to its attractive foliage and purple flowers. The leaves of Lamium purpureum var. hybridum have been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, and are believed to offer several health benefits. The plant is thought to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents of Lamium purpureum var. hybridum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
